generate_podspec_from_bazel: run the script with --version flag to generate abseil.podspec from BUILD.bazel files
collect_rules_from_directory: recursively collect all cc_library rules from BUILD.bazel files under a given root path
parse_bazel_xml_rule: parse a Bazel XML rule element into a Rule namedtuple with normalized paths
normalize_bazel_paths: convert Bazel label paths like //absl/strings:dir/header.h to absl/strings/dir/header.h
filter_relevant_rules: filter Bazel rules to keep only non-empty cc_library rules that are not test-only
